name: Write Block
description: Writes a block definition and optional system prompt to the proper directory structure. Encapsulates path resolution, naming conventions, and directory creation.

inputs.name: Block JSON
inputs.description: The full block definition JSON. Must contain 'id' and 'blockType' fields.

inputs.name: System Prompt
inputs.description: Optional system prompt markdown content. Written as system-prompt.md in the block directory.

outputs.description: The block ID extracted from the JSON
